stem: Liza spends 40 minutes cooking dinner and 2 hours cleaning the house. What is the ratio of her cooking time to her cleaning time?
hints: The two times are in different units. A ratio needs both amounts in the same unit.
Change 2 hours into minutes. 1 hour = 60 minutes.
2 hours = 2 × 60 minutes. Write cooking : cleaning in minutes, then divide both by the biggest number that goes into both.

solution.methodName: Convert to the same unit, then simplify

steps.action: Change hours to minutes: 2 hours = 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.
steps.why: You can only compare amounts in the same unit. Minutes are easier here because they avoid fractions.
40 is the biggest number that divides both 40 and 120.

steps.action: The ratio of cooking time to cleaning time is 1 : 3.

trapNotes.20 : 1: This uses 40 : 2 without changing the hours to minutes. Convert to the same unit first.
trapNotes.1 : 5: This treats 1 hour as 100 minutes (40 : 200). An hour has 60 minutes, so 2 hours is 120 minutes.
trapNotes.3 : 1: This is cleaning to cooking (120 : 40). The question asks for cooking time first.
